series.title: The Sunset Talent Show

characters.name: Mango Milo
characters.look: A young golden-orange mango boy with a small green leaf on top, big hopeful brown eyes, and a shy smile, wearing a white resort staff polo, blue shorts and a towel over his shoulder.

characters.name: Grapefruit Gloria
characters.look: A glossy pink grapefruit young woman with sparkly eyelashes and a smug smirk, wearing a sequined gold gown, a flower crown and big sunglasses.

characters.name: Mr Grapefruit
characters.look: A large wrinkled pink grapefruit man with a thick grey moustache and narrow angry eyes, wearing a white linen suit, a gold chain and a straw hat.

characters.name: Granny Papaya
characters.look: A small wrinkled orange papaya grandmother with kind twinkling eyes and round glasses, wearing a faded red lifeguard swimsuit, a white sun visor and a whistle on a cord.

so_far: Part 1: Mocked towel boy Mango Milo wins the beach talent show with a perfect coconut trick shot, and when Gloria demands his papers, an old resort deed with the Mango name falls out.
Part 2: Granny Papaya reveals Milo's grandpa built the resort, but Gloria spots where Milo hid the deed and Mr Grapefruit dumps the coconut into the sea.
series.cliffhanger: With the final starting at sunrise, Milo must get the drifting coconut back even though he cannot swim.

history.title: His Best Friend Swapped the Plans at Midnight (Part 1)
history.premise: The Bulldozer Betrayal (part 1): Carrot Carl secretly swaps Broccoli Bob's blueprints, making Bob sink the boss's trailer and get fired while Carl takes his bulldozer.

history.title: The Fired Worker Found the Fake Blueprint (Part 2)
history.premise: The Bulldozer Betrayal (part 2): Bob finds the fake blueprint covered in orange dust, Carl nearly crushes the evidence with the bulldozer, and Mr Pineapple catches them both just as Carl blames Bob.

history.title: One Orange Smudge Exposed the Real Saboteur (Part 3)
history.premise: The Bulldozer Betrayal (part 3): Mr Pineapple traces the carrot dust to Carl, who flees in the bulldozer and sinks it in the mud pit, while Bob rescues him, becomes foreman and gets his bulldozer back.

history.title: He Lied About Owning the Restaurant (Part 1)
history.premise: The Champagne Liar (part 1): Broke Lemon Lenny lies to Madame Plum that he owns a champagne empire and the fancy restaurant, then gets handed a giant bill and a mysterious note from the quiet waiter.

history.title: He Filled Champagne Bottles With Lemon Water (Part 2)
history.premise: The Champagne Liar (part 2): Pierre confronts Lenny in the kitchen and demands he tell Sofia the truth, but Lenny fills the champagne bottles with sour lemon water instead, raising Madame Plum's suspicions.

history.title: The Quiet Waiter Was the Real Owner All Along (Part 3)
history.premise: The Champagne Liar (part 3): Pierre reveals he owns the restaurant, Madame Plum exposes the lemon water, and Lenny gets stuck washing dishes to pay his bill while Sofia finds happiness with honest Pierre.

history.title: The Muddy Potato Who Silenced the Whole Farm (Part 1)
history.premise: The Farm VIP Star (part 1): Mocked outcast Potato Pip shocks the farm with a perfect-score song at the talent show, but on the eve of the final his microphone vanishes and a cherry stem is left behind.

history.title: His Mic Was Stolen So Granny Built Him One (Part 2)
history.premise: The Farm VIP Star (part 2): Granny Corn helps Pip build a tin can microphone and he wows the final, but Celeste secretly slips a fake note into the judge's winner envelope.

history.title: The Tin Can Mic Caught the Cheater Red-Handed (Part 3)
history.premise: The Farm VIP Star (part 3): Pip's tin can microphone exposes Celeste's forged winner note, she is disqualified and sent to sweep the stage, and Pip is crowned the Farm VIP Star with Granny Corn by his side.

history.title: She Sued Her Own Daughter Over a Secret Recipe (Part 1)
history.premise: The Olive Oil Inheritance (part 1): Mama Olive sues Lime Lucy for stealing the family recipe to give Grape Gary everything, but her own recipe book proves Lucy invented it.

history.title: Grandpa Froze His Last Secret in a Jar of Oil (Part 2)
history.premise: The Olive Oil Inheritance (part 2): Nonno Avocado reveals Grandpa's frozen will demanding a cook-off, and Gary secretly sabotages Lucy's dish with vinegar until Nonno spots a bottle in his pocket.

history.title: Her Golden Son Turned On Her in Court (Part 3)
history.premise: The Olive Oil Inheritance (part 3): Mama Olive takes the blame to protect Gary, but he betrays her, Nonno's saved jar proves Lucy's sauce is the true recipe, and Lucy inherits everything while Gary and Mama work in her restaurant.

history.title: The Tiny Pea Dropped a Paper That Shocked the Farm (Part 1)
history.premise: The Dwarf Planet Pea (part 1): Mocked tiny Pea Pluto wows the farm talent show with a bucket tap dance, and when jealous Watermelon Wanda searches him, an old birth certificate in Farmer Pumpkin's handwriting falls out bearing the Pumpkin family name.

history.title: The Lost Seed the Farmer Never Stopped Missing (Part 2)
history.premise: The Dwarf Planet Pea (part 2): Farmer Pumpkin's old chest reveals Pluto is his long-lost seed, but Wanda overhears, swaps the birth certificate for a fake and publicly claims to be his real child.

history.title: She Locked Him Away to Steal His Father's Farm (Part 3)
history.premise: The Dwarf Planet Pea (part 3): Pluto finds his baby blanket hidden in Wanda's tiara box, but she locks him in the root cellar, and his desperate tap rhythm reaches the farmer just as Wanda forces his hand to sign the farm away.

history.title: The Secret Song That Saved the Farm (Part 4)
history.premise: The Dwarf Planet Pea (part 4): Farmer Pumpkin recognizes Pluto's lullaby tap rhythm, tears up the deed, frees his son from the cellar, exposes Wanda with the stitched baby blanket, and sends her to scrub buckets.

history.title: She Inherited a Rusty Submarine and Everyone Laughed (Part 1)
history.premise: The Submarine Fortune (part 1): Kiwi Kiki inherits only a rusty submarine while Melon Marvin takes the farm, but she discovers a hidden gold fortune at the bottom of the duck pond just as Marvin starts draining it with her trapped inside.

history.title: Buried in Mud, She Follows the Ducks to a Secret (Part 2)
history.premise: The Submarine Fortune (part 2): Kiki follows Grandpa's duck clue through a hidden pipe to a secret barn cellar holding the real gold and his true will, while Marvin finds only rocks and traps her inside.

history.title: She Rolled Grandpa's Submarine Right Into His Signing (Part 3)
history.premise: The Submarine Fortune (part 3): Kiki escapes through the pipe, drives Grandpa's secret tank-track submarine into Marvin's deed signing, proves his will is fake, and wins the farm and gold while Marvin is stuck scrubbing the duck pond.

history.title: The Towel Boy Who Stunned the Whole Beach (Part 1)
history.premise: The Sunset Talent Show (part 1): Mocked towel boy Mango Milo wins the beach talent show with a perfect coconut trick shot, and when Gloria demands his papers, an old resort deed with the Mango name falls out.

history.title: The Coconut Hiding His Grandpa's Secret (Part 2)
history.premise: The Sunset Talent Show (part 2): Granny Papaya reveals Milo's grandpa built the resort, but Gloria spots where Milo hid the deed and Mr Grapefruit dumps the coconut into the sea.
